# Synthetic Luna regression inputs

These small fixtures were authored for the owner's earlier prepared-conversion evaluation. They are copied unchanged from the preserved research checkout; no private source files are included.

- `nested.html`: nested literal list ordinals, reversed uppercase labels and two occurrences of an identical figure; this input contains no table.
- `footnotes.docx`: authored structured document with footnotes and inline figures.
- `metadata.eml`: meaningful named mail headers, alternatives and a table with identifiers/blank cells.
- `blank-comments.xlsx`: two worksheets, four blank-cell comments (including two comment-only rows), two formulas with unavailable cached results, leading-zero identifiers and spreadsheet prose. Cached formula results are covered by separate synthetic reader tests.
- `process-scan.pdf`: substantive process text, diagram presentation and a scanned page.

The task evidence records input hashes and targeted provider/source inspection. Passing the structural checks does not establish universal conversion fidelity.
